meta.name: godot-gdscript
meta.description: GDScript 4.x syntax reference — types, operators, classes, signals, patterns, and common API. Load when writing or reviewing GDScript code.

copy.tagline_en: Look up GDScript syntax and API reference

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能编写和审查 GDScript 4.x 代码，包括类型、运算符、类、信号、常用 API 等语法参考。
howto.when: 当用户要求编写或审查 Godot 引擎的 GDScript 代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 GDScript 脚本，让角色跳跃。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含跳跃逻辑的脚本。

say.text: 检查这段 GDScript 代码有没有语法错误。
say.note: Claude 会审查代码并指出问题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can write and review GDScript 4.x code, including syntax reference for types, operators, classes, signals, and common API.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to write or review GDScript code for the Godot engine.

say_en.text: Write a GDScript script for character jumping.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a script with jump logic.

say_en.text: Check this GDScript code for syntax errors.
say_en.note: Claude will review the code and point out issues.
